Source: Radio galaxies have been traditionally classified as Fanaroff-Riley (FR) I and II, although some exhibit more complex 'bent' morphologies arising from environmental factors or intrinsic properties.

Yoruba: Rádíò àwọn ìràwọ̀ jẹ́ èyí tí a ti pín sí ọ̀wọ́ Fanaroff-Riley (FR) I àti II, àwọn mìíràn ní mọfọ́lọ́jì ‘ìbẹ̀rẹ̀’ tó le tó ru láti ipa agbègbè tàbí ẹ̀ya ìjímìjí nǹkan.

Hausa: An rarraba taurarin radiyo bisa al'ada a matsayin Fanaroff-Riley (FR) I da II, ko da yake wasu suna baje kolin siffofi masu sarƙaƙƙiya waɗanda suka taso daga abubuwan muhalli ko abubuwan da suka dace.
Northern Sotho: Maphotho a molanaledi a hlophilwe mathomong bjalo ka Fanaroff-Riley (FR) I le II, le ge e le gore a manwge a tšweletša dikarolo tše di 'kgopamilego' ka lebaka la maemo a tikologo ya tšona goba diteng tša tšona tša ka gare.

Source: In this work we present the FIRST Classifier, an on-line system for automated classification of Compact and Extended radio sources.

Source: We developed the FIRST Classifier based on a trained Deep Convolutional Neural Network Model to automate the morphological classification of com- pact and extended radio sources observed in the FIRST radio survey.
Luganda: Twakola Ekibinjawazo EKISOOKA okusinziira ku mutetenkanyirizo gw’omuyungo kasengejja-bifaananyi okusobozesa emminjawaza y’ensulo y’amayengo ga leediyo agaafunibwa mu kunoonyereza okwasooka okuba nga yeekola yokka.

Source: Our model achieved an overall accuracy of 97% and a recall of 98%, 100%, 98% and 93% for Compact, BENT, FRI and FRII galaxies respectively.

Hausa: Samfurinmu ya sami daidaito gabaɗaya na kashi 97% da tunawa na kashi 98%, 100%, 98% da 93% don Ƙarami, BENT, FRI da tauraron FRII bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa rena o fihleletše kakaretšo ya nepagalo ya 97% le boipiletšo bja 98%, 100%, 98% le 93% ya melanaledi ya Teteano, BENT, FRI le FRII.

Source: The current version of the FIRST classifier is able to identify the morphological class for a single source or for a list of sources as Compact or Extended (FRI, FRII and BENT).
